column1: # EXCLUDED_CASES.tsv -- logtalk_iso (CASE granularity, inside the tests.lgt files; never the package file census, which reads EXCLUDED.tsv as excluded FILES): the conformance cases OUT of the published denominator, one row per case: group:case<TAB>CLASS<TAB>the case's own condition. Read by SCRIP scripts/util_logtalk_grade.py; shipped 3617 = denominator 3577 + Excl 40.

# THE RULING (Lon 2026-10-05, in-chat to the ceo, verbatim: "Mark the Windows dependent tests as Excluded." and "Mark the bounded-integer tests as Excluded."; ceo CEO-1519, CEO-1520). An excluded case is never run and never counted as pass or fail; every other case is in the denominator (Lon, CEO-1518: "We do want ALL test programs to run. We have NO expected failures. We expect to have ALL features.").

# WINDOWS_ONLY: the case sits in the :- if(...) branch this suite compiles only on Windows; the SAME case name's unix else-branch is graded. BOUNDED_INTEGERS_ONLY: the case runs only where integers are bounded; SCRIP is unbounded like SWI (ceo measured: bounded=false, no max_integer flag, 9223372036854775807 + 1 = 9223372036854775808).

# EXCLUSIVE_BRANCH and DOTLESS_FLOAT_READ (ceo CEO-1524, 2026-10-05, on the coo's ask): four if/else pairs expect opposite outcomes of one goal, so no engine passes both -- the exclusive-configuration class of the Windows and bounded rulings; FEATURE PRESENT is decided for all four (util_logtalk_extract.RULED: ^/2 callable for bagof_3 and setof_3, the infix-and-postfix dialect branch of op_3 iso_op_3_10, '|' an operator for op_3 iso_op_3_21) and each sibling branch is an EXCLUSIVE_BRANCH row; lgt_number_34 and lgt_number_35 read 1e33 and 1E33 expecting syntax_error, while SCRIP's default reads a dotless float as SWI does (11 SWI suite programs depend on it) and the strict ISO reading is built under set_prolog_flag(iso, true) by the cfo.
# THE LIST IS A RECORD, NOT A MASK: the grader REFUSES a row naming no such case, a row whose case does not carry the condition its class names, and a case a guard takes out that no row names.
